name: Whishper
description: Transcribe any audio to text, translate and edit subtitles completely locally with a web UI.

variables.name: Profile
variables.description: Set to 'gpu' to use GPU. Need to select GPU-compatible image variant.

variables.name: LibreTranslate URL
variables.description: The URL of the LibreTranslate instance to use for translations.

variables.name: Whisper Server
variables.description: The hostname where Whishper is being served, without the protocol.

variables.name: Whisper Models
variables.description: Comma-separated list of Whisper models to download on first run.

variables.name: Internal Models Directory
variables.description: Internal path to the Whisper models directory. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Uploads Directory
variables.description: Internal path to the uploads directory. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: CPU Thread Count
variables.description: The number of CPU threads to use when transcribing.
